name: ai-commander
title: AI-Commander
description: Run your own AI prompts on selected text in any app, with your own API keys.
author: dhimmel

commands.name: run-prompt
commands.title: Run Prompt Quicklink
commands.subtitle: AI-Commander
commands.description: Runs a saved prompt for a quicklink. For everyday use, open Run Prompt.

commands.name: prompt-session
commands.title: Run Prompt
commands.subtitle: AI-Commander
commands.description: Pick a prompt, review the result and its changes, and insert it.

commands.name: manage-prompts
commands.title: Manage Prompts
commands.subtitle: AI-Commander
commands.description: Create, edit, duplicate, import, and export prompts and snippets.

commands.name: manage-models
commands.title: Models & Providers
commands.subtitle: AI-Commander
commands.description: Browse models, set favorites and the default model, and test providers.

preferences.name: anthropicApiKey
preferences.title: Anthropic API Key
preferences.description: Claude models go directly to Anthropic. Without this key, they run through OpenRouter.

preferences.name: openaiApiKey
preferences.title: OpenAI API Key
preferences.description: GPT models go directly to OpenAI. Without this key, they run through OpenRouter.

preferences.name: geminiApiKey
preferences.title: Gemini API Key
preferences.description: Gemini models go directly to Google. Use a paid project for work text. Without this key, they run through OpenRouter.

preferences.name: openrouterApiKey
preferences.title: OpenRouter API Key
preferences.description: Enables all other model families, and any of the above without its own key.

scripts.check: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test
